notes.title: Patch 1.7!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 
[b]We are finally happy to announce that a new update is ready to be downloaded.[/b] It features core improvements,corrections and of course new stuff.


[img]http://elisatheinnkeeper.rel.to/store/thefall_duel.jpg[/img]


[h1]General:[/h1]
[i]
- Improved Core engine stability and performance.
- Implemented the text speed option.
- Improved quality of the characters models.
- Overhaul for the textbox character images.
- Improved the general quality of the story script. (English, Italian)
- Several improvements to the game UI  

- The Cat side quest title not showing correctly in the german version of the game -> fixed.
- Ui cut menu titles in the Russian version of the game -> fixed.
- German Story text script not correctly in-line with the art -> fixed.
[/i]

[h1]Additional H-content updates [/h1]
[i]
-Corrected a critical bug that caused the game not to show the correct story script for players who have played the original game in Italian, German, French, Russian.
- Artworks transitions have been improved
[/i]

[h1]Last but not least:[/h1]
[b] Our Additional h-content is coming for Mac too![/b]
We are also trying to include the additional content as a patch (instead as a standalone .exe) since this feature wasn't so mutch appreciated. We will keep you updated.

Thanks for your support so far and have a nice day!

[h1]<3 Neoclassic Games[/h1]

notes.title: Patch 1.5 - Visual Upgrade & Additional Content
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 
[b]We are finally happy to announce that a new update is finally here!.[/b] It features some important new features and of course something that everybody has been waiting for a long time.

[h1]First of all -> Visual Upgrade[/h1]

[img]http://elisatheinnkeeper.rel.to/store/visualupdate.jpg[/img]

[b]Our Artists have been hard at work in order to improve the quality of our Artwork and Backgrounds even further. [/b]
Prepare yourself for an even more immersive experience!


[h1]New Content:[/h1]

[img]http://elisatheinnkeeper.rel.to/store/wedding.jpg[/img]

You have asked and we have listened guys.
[h1]This update features more than 500Mb of brand new content... with no requirements to access it, completely uncensored and completely FREE... (yeah seriously).[/h1]

if we want to be more specific:

- [i]Almost 10k words[/i]
- [i]18 New Artworks (standard and H-rated)[/i]


Unfortunately Valve doesn't allow this kind of material on their platform so you can get it [url=http://elisatheinnkeeper.rel.to/#GetOurGame] on our website[/url] . (We did not release it in order to promote anything else, or make a profit... it is just a gift).


[h1]General & Fixes:[/h1]
[i]- Corrected a few bugs concerning our in-game choices
- Few optimization to our core engine
[/i]



Good luck!

<3 Neoclassic Games

notes.title: Patch 1.2 is Here!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 
[b]We are finally happy to announce that a new update is ready to be downloaded.[/b] It features core improvements,corrections and of course new stuff.


[img]http://elisatheinnkeeper.rel.to/store/update12.jpg[/img]

[h1]This time we really want to thank Fun Ghoul for her amazing feedback and support.[/h1] 
But let's get to the important part, the patch notes.


[h1]Core improvements:[/h1]
[i]- Improved the quality of the art while playing with the 4k option turned on.[/i]
[i]- Adjusted Karma points gain and loss after dialogue choices.[/i]

[h1]New Stuff:[/h1]
[i]- Added a new background in order to differenciate between the Act 1 Inn and Elisa's inn.
- Added 2 textbox images for Arianna.[/i]


[h1]General & Fixes:[/h1]
[i]- Lots of improvements to the English version of the game
- Our characters change expression more often offering a more dynamic experience.
- Few optimizations to the music section.
- You can now unlock every song no matter the choices you made during the game.

...
...
- and last but not least...[/i]

[img]http://elisatheinnkeeper.rel.to/store/freeartbook.png[/img]
[h1]If you got this update, you will find your artbook inside the game folder.[/h1]


Hope you guys have a wonderful day, we really worked hard in order to bring you this update.

<3 Neoclassic Games

notes.title: Update 1.0 is here!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 
We are finally happy to announce that with this update [b]Elisa the innkeeper is not an early access game anymore.[/b]

[img]http://elisatheinnkeeper.rel.to/store/update.jpg[/img]

[h1]This is our biggest update ever and we really worked hard in order to make this game better![/h1] Your feedback has proven incredibly useful, thank you so much!



But let's get to the important part, the patch notes.

[h1]Core improvements:[/h1]
[i]- Better performance while playing in 1080p resolution or lower
- Improved game visuals and stability while playing in 4K resolution
- Major improvements and rebalancing of the Karma system[/i]

[h1]New Stuff:[/h1]
[i]- New Character! Arianna!
- Additional sound effects
- Implemented a new feature that allows players to skip only already seen text
- 7 Additional Artworks
- Added 4 new choices
- Added 1 additional Side Quest
- The "Special chapter" is now available and replayable
- 3 New Epilogues
- More text, dialogues and descriptions in general (10k more words added to the story).[/i]

[h1]General & Fixes:[/h1]
[i]- Lots of improvements to the Italian, English, French version of the game
- Major improvements to the Russian and German version of the game
- Lots of corrections concerning our characters disposition on the screen
- A notification shows when a new chapter is unlocked
- Lots of typos corrected
- and a lot more...[/i]


[h1]But we are not done here[/h1]
As promised, additional [b]FREE DLCs are coming.[/b] 
These are  [b]Standalone stories[/b], so feel free to enjoy our Main Story without any concern... it is complete.

A sneak peek:
[img]http://elisatheinnkeeper.rel.to/store/update2.jpg[/img]

Have a nice day!

notes.title: Elisa the innkeeper - Patch 0.21
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
Just 2 days have passed since our game launched on steam and we already have a brand new patch based on your feedback.
Keep supporing us, we really do care about your opinions!
[i]
[h1]General:[/h1]
- Improved game performance
- Skip mode is now a little bit faster (we are working on a feature that will allow you to adjust the speed as you like).
- Improved save/load mechanics
- Inproved character expressions transitions

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
- Adjusted some artworks and songs in order to make some game scenes look better.
- Lots of corrections to the main story script
- Corrections to the Italian and English version of the game.
[/i]
And this is just the beginning! There is much to do and we are eager to improve this game as much as possible.
Thanks!
